# Practical tasks {#sec-labs .unnumbered}

One lab per session, building the same red thread the script follows: from
the local Ubuntu laboratory of Session 1 to the hardened, monitored,
recoverable service the integrated case defends in Session 13. Each chapter
links to its lab at the end of its exercises; each lab links back to its
chapter.

::: {.callout-note}
These pages **mirror** the lab worksheets so you can read them alongside
the script and follow the cross-links. **The official worksheets remain
the PDFs distributed via Canvas** - work from those, together with the
weekly answer documents.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## How the labs work (applies all semester)

Work through each lab *in your group* and discuss the answers together. At
the next session you briefly talk the teacher through your answers -
*verbally*, just so progress can be tracked (nothing is handed in, signed
or graded here). The review runs *one session behind*, so you always have
the week in between: Session 2 → Exercise 1; Session 3 → Exercise 2; …
Session N → Exercise N-1. Each week you fill in that session's **answer
document** (`SKY2100_ExerciseN_Answers.docx`, distributed via Canvas); the
final home-exam report is built from these weekly documents.
:::
